sub: Messages your academy sends on its own, as if you wrote them: the welcome, the first week, a nudge when someone stops showing up… They land in each person's inbox with your name and your photo.
vacio: You don't have any automated messages yet. Start with a template: it turns on with one click and you can change it whenever you like.
plantillasSub: Already written in your academy's language. Turn them on as they are or edit them later.

disparador.DAYS_AFTER_JOIN: {dias, plural, one {The day after they join} other {# days after they join}}
disparador.INACTIVE: {dias, plural, one {If they haven't logged in for # day} other {If they haven't logged in for # days}}

disparadorOpcion.INACTIVE: If they don't log in for X days (win-back)
disparadorOpcion.ANNIVERSARY: On their subscription or membership anniversary

reenvio: {dias, plural, one {sent again the next day if they still haven't logged in} other {sent again after # days if they still haven't logged in}}
firma: Signed by {nombre}: they arrive with their name and photo.
reglaUnoAlDia: At most one automated message per person per day: if two are due, the second waits until the next day.
reglaEquipo: They are never sent to your team (teachers and admins).
reglaNoRepetir: Nobody gets the same message twice.
reglaDesdeActivar: Only people who meet the condition after you turn it on count: turning on “30 days after they join” doesn't message all your existing members at once.
franjaAyuda: Outside these hours, the message waits until it's daytime where each person lives.
esperaManual: If you wrote to them yourself
esperaHoras: Don't send if I wrote to them in the last {horas} h
esperaAyuda: So nobody gets an automated message right after a conversation with you.
borrarConfirmar: Delete this automated message? What has already been sent stays in the conversations.
reenviarSi: If they still haven't logged in, send it again once after
variablesAyuda: Click a variable to add it: it's replaced with each person's details when it's sent.

variable.name: Their name
variable.course: The course it's about (the one they finished or are halfway through)
variable.introLink: Link to introduce themselves to the community

correoAyuda: They also get an email from your academy. Anyone who unsubscribed from community emails won't receive it.
vistaPreviaAyuda: Write the message to see how it will arrive.

tarjeta.cargando: Who hasn't logged in for days, who paid and didn't start…
tarjeta.nadie: Nobody right now: everyone is up to date.
tarjeta.personas: {n, plural, one {# person worth reaching out to} other {# people worth reaching out to}}

riesgo.sub: People worth reaching out to before they leave: they haven't logged in for days, they paid and haven't started, or they got stuck halfway through a course.
riesgo.sinRecuperacion: Turn on the win-back message to add people with one click. It's sent with the same rules as the rest.
riesgo.vacioTexto: Nobody has gone more than {dias} days without logging in, and there are no unstarted purchases or stalled courses.
riesgo.anadido: {nombre} will get the win-back message (during their hours and no more than one a day).
riesgo.enviado: Message sent to {nombre}. You'll see it in Messages.
riesgo.moduloApagado: Automated messages are turned off in this academy.

motivo.sinEntrar: {dias, plural, one {Hasn't logged in for # day} other {Hasn't logged in for # days}}

riesgo.escribirAyuda: It arrives as a direct message from you. You can change anything before sending it.
